items.title: Many people ask in DM how can they use credit cards like HSBC, Indusind etc to make GST payment as they see only a few banks on the GST payment page and can’t find issuers like HSBC, IndusInd Bank & other popular credit card issuers. 🤔 Here’s the important point 👇 You can pay GST using ANY credit card. 💳 When you select “Credit Card” on the GST portal, the banks you see are actually Payment Gateways, NOT the list of credit card issuers supported. For example, if you select HDFC Bank as the payment gateway, on the next page you can enter details of any bank's credit card such as HSBC Credit Card details for example, and make the GST payment. ✅ Similarly, you can use cards issued by other banks like IndusInd Bank, Yes Bank etc. Most payment gateways support: • Visa ✅ • Mastercard ✅ • RuPay ✅ Diners Club and are supported by selected gateways. For example, American Express cards can be used through the Canara Bank payment gateway — although, Amex transactions can fail quite frequently. So, don’t get confused by the limited list of banks shown on the GST portal. That is the list of payment gateways, NOT the list of credit cards you can use. 💳 Hope this clears up the confusion! 😊 📘 Visit SpendWisely Blog: Detailed credit card reviews & guides 👉 https://spendwisely.in Some links may be referral links in the above post.
